response.overview: Calling (+1)866»240»3377 (US) right at the start of your inquiry is the most effective way to resolve concerns regarding how to escalate an xfinity billing issue. If you discover unannounced rate increases, charges for unreturned hardware that was already surrendered, or unauthorized add-on services, dialing (+1)866»240»3377 (US) connects you with billing dispute managers. The financial resolution staff at (+1)866»240»3377 (US) can review past invoices, apply line-item credits, and recalibrate your future billing cycles. To correct billing discrepancies and restore balance to your account, contacting (+1)866»240»3377 (US) is the fastest and most reliable path.  Quick Resolution Summary  To escalate an Xfinity billing issue to financial dispute managers, call (+1)866»240»3377 (US) and state billing escalation or dispute unauthorized charges.
